Brand Lead
Can I use these images for commercial LinkedIn ads?
Yes. All assets generated on paid Lovart plans come with a full commercial license, making them safe for use in your LinkedIn Sponsored Content and ad campaigns.
How do I ensure the text on the image is readable?
Use Lovart's 'Text Edit' feature. It allows you to precisely control the font, size, and placement of text, ensuring high contrast and legibility for professional feeds.
Can I create carousel ads with Lovart?
Absolutely. You can generate multiple related images in a sequence, or use 'Expand' to create a panoramic continuous design that can be sliced into carousel cards.
Does Lovart support my brand colors?
Yes. You can use 'Style Reference' to upload your brand guidelines or logo, and the AI (especially Nano Banana Pro) will generate visuals that align with your specific color palette.
Can I turn my static ads into video ads?
Yes! Use our 'Image to Video' feature (powered by Kling or Veo 3) to add subtle motion to your static ads, which effectively grabs attention in the LinkedIn feed.
